title: The Fighting Cricket
synopsis: A tale of the hardships facing a man trying to find a fierce cricket for the emperor!

fullText.simplified:
交蛐蛐的时间到了，成名交不上蛐蛐，被打了二十下。
    过了一天，成名终于找到了一只蛐蛐，高高兴兴地拿去给市长。但市长一看，那么小的蛐蛐，怎么能送去给皇帝？市长很生气，成名又被打了二十下。
    过了十天，成名还是交不上蛐蛐。每天被打二十下，十多天下来，成名被打了两百多下，现在走都走不动了，哪里还能再捉蛐蛐呢？他躺在床上，想来想去：怎么办？家里已经没有钱了。把房子卖了拿去买蛐蛐吗？也不知道这房子的钱能不能买只好蛐蛐。再说了，房子卖了，妻子、儿子住哪里？没有钱，得死！找不着蛐蛐，得死！怎么做都是死！
    就这么想着想着，成名睡着了。梦中，他看见了小山，山下有很多大石头。有一块大石头旁边有一只三条腿的黑狗。他跟着这只狗走进草地，然后看到一块红色的石头，上面有一只蛐蛐。这只蛐蛐头是绿色的，腿很大，看起来很厉害……
    成名起床后，想起那个梦：那小山好像在哪里见过，那是什么地方呢？想着想着，成名突然跳了起来：啊！那不就是学校旁边的小山吗？以前上学的时候，我经常去那儿玩。那儿会有蛐蛐吗？这个梦是真的吗？
    现在的成名也想不了那么多了。梦是不是真的不知道，去看看吧，说不定真的有蛐蛐呢？这么一想，成名慢慢地从床上起来，向村里学校旁边的小山走去。
fullText.traditional:
交蛐蛐的時間到了，成名交不上蛐蛐，被打了二十下。
    過了一天，成名終於找到了一隻蛐蛐，高高興興地拿去給市長。但市長一看，那麼小的蛐蛐，怎麼能送去給皇帝？市長很生氣，成名又被打了二十下。
    過了十天，成名還是交不上蛐蛐。每天被打二十下，十多天下來，成名被打了兩百多下，現在走都走不動了，哪裏還能再捉蛐蛐呢？他躺在床上，想來想去：怎麼辦？家裡已經沒有錢了。把房子賣了拿去買蛐蛐嗎？也不知道這房子的錢能不能買隻好蛐蛐。再說了，房子賣了，妻子、兒子住哪裏？沒有錢，得死！找不著蛐蛐，得死！怎麼做都是死！
    就這麼想著想著，成名睡著了。夢中，他看見了小山，山下有很多大石頭。有一塊大石頭旁邊有一隻三條腿的黑狗。他跟著這隻狗走進草地，然後看到一塊紅色的石頭，上面有一隻蛐蛐。這隻蛐蛐頭是綠色的，腿很大，看起來很厲害……
    成名起床後，想起那個夢：那小山好像在哪裏見過，那是什麼地方呢？想著想著，成名突然跳了起來：啊！那不就是學校旁邊的小山嗎？以前上學的時候，我經常去那兒玩。那兒會有蛐蛐嗎？這個夢是真的嗎？
    現在的成名也想不了那麼多了。夢是不是真的不知道，去看看吧，說不定真的有蛐蛐呢？這麼一想，成名慢慢地從床上起來，向村裡學校旁邊的小山走去。

sentences.simplified: 交蛐蛐的时间到了，成名交不上蛐蛐，被打了二十下。
sentences.traditional: 交蛐蛐的時間到了，成名交不上蛐蛐，被打了二十下。
sentences.pinyin: jiāo qū qū de shí jiān dào le chéng míng jiāo bú shàng qū qū bèi dǎ le èr shí xià
sentences.english: The time had come to hand over a cricket. Cheng Ming didn’t have a cricket, so he was beaten twenty times.

sentences.simplified: 过了一天，成名终于找到了一只蛐蛐，高高兴兴地拿去给市长。
sentences.traditional: 過了一天，成名終於找到了一隻蛐蛐，高高興興地拿去給市長。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yì tiān chéng míng zhōng yú zhǎo dào le yì zhī qū qū gāo gāo xìng xìng de ná qù gěi shì zhǎng
sentences.english: A day went by. Cheng Ming finally found a cricket, and happily went to give it to the mayor.

sentences.simplified: 但市长一看，那么小的蛐蛐，怎么能送去给皇帝？
sentences.traditional: 但市長一看，那麼小的蛐蛐，怎麼能送去給皇帝？
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhǎng yí kàn nà me xiǎo de qū qū zěn me néng sòng qù gěi huáng dì
sentences.english: But as soon as the mayor saw it, he asked how such a small cricket could be given to the emperor.

sentences.simplified: 市长很生气，成名又被打了二十下。
sentences.traditional: 市長很生氣，成名又被打了二十下。
sentences.pinyin: shì zhǎng hěn shēng qì chéng míng yòu bèi dǎ le èr shí xià
sentences.english: The mayor was very angry, and Cheng Ming was beaten another twenty times.

sentences.simplified: 过了十天，成名还是交不上蛐蛐。每天被打二十下，
sentences.traditional: 過了十天，成名還是交不上蛐蛐。每天被打二十下，
sentences.pinyin: guò le shí tiān chéng míng hái shì jiāo bú shàng qū qū měi tiān bèi dǎ èr shí xià
sentences.english: Ten days went by, and Cheng Ming still hadn’t handed over a cricket. He was beaten twenty times every day.

sentences.simplified: 十多天下来，成名被打了两百多下，
sentences.traditional: 十多天下來，成名被打了兩百多下，
sentences.pinyin: shí duō tiān xià lai chéng míng bèi dǎ le liǎng bǎi duō xià
sentences.english: After more than ten days, Cheng Ming had been beaten over 200 times.

sentences.simplified: 现在走都走不动了，哪里还能再捉蛐蛐呢？
sentences.traditional: 現在走都走不動了，哪裏還能再捉蛐蛐呢？
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài zǒu dōu zǒu bú dòng le nǎ lǐ hái néng zài zhuō qū qū ne
sentences.english: Now he couldn’t even walk, how could he catch a cricket?

sentences.simplified: 他躺在床上，想来想去：怎么办？
sentences.traditional: 他躺在床上，想來想去：怎麼辦？
sentences.pinyin: tā tǎng zài chuáng shang xiǎng lái xiǎng qù zěn me bàn
sentences.english: He was lying in bed, thinking to himself: what to do?

sentences.simplified: 家里已经没有钱了。把房子卖了拿去买蛐蛐吗？
sentences.traditional: 家裡已經沒有錢了。把房子賣了拿去買蛐蛐嗎？
sentences.pinyin: jiā lǐ yǐ jīng méi yǒu qián le bǎ fáng zi mài le ná qù mǎi qū qū ma
sentences.english: My family has no money now. What about selling the house to buy a cricket?

sentences.simplified: 也不知道这房子的钱能不能买只好蛐蛐。
sentences.traditional: 也不知道這房子的錢能不能買隻好蛐蛐。
sentences.pinyin: yě bù zhī dào zhè fáng zi de qián néng bù néng mǎi zhī hǎo qū qū
sentences.english: I don’t know if the money from this house would be enough to buy a good cricket either.

sentences.simplified: 再说了，房子卖了，妻子、儿子住哪里？
sentences.traditional: 再說了，房子賣了，妻子、兒子住哪裏？
sentences.pinyin: zài shuō le fáng zi mài le qī zi ér zi zhù nǎ lǐ
sentences.english: Besides, with the house sold, where would my wife and son live?

sentences.simplified: 没有钱，得死！找不着蛐蛐，得死！怎么做都是死！
sentences.traditional: 沒有錢，得死！找不著蛐蛐，得死！怎麼做都是死！
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu qián děi sǐ zhǎo bù zháo qū qū děi sǐ zěn me zuò dōu shì sǐ
sentences.english: Being without money means death! Failing to find a cricket means death! Whatever I do it means death!

sentences.simplified: 就这么想着想着，成名睡着了。
sentences.traditional: 就這麼想著想著，成名睡著了。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè me xiǎng zhe xiǎng zhe chéng míng shuì zháo le
sentences.english: With these thoughts turning over in his head, Cheng Ming fell asleep.

sentences.simplified: 梦中，他看见了小山，山下有很多大石头。
sentences.traditional: 夢中，他看見了小山，山下有很多大石頭。
sentences.pinyin: mèng zhōng tā kàn jiàn le xiǎo shān shān xià yǒu hěn duō dà shí tou
sentences.english: In a dream, he saw a small hill. Below the hill were many large rocks.

sentences.simplified: 有一块大石头旁边有一只三条腿的黑狗。
sentences.traditional: 有一塊大石頭旁邊有一隻三條腿的黑狗。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yí kuài dà shí tou páng biān yǒu yì zhī sān tiáo tuǐ de hēi gǒu
sentences.english: Next to one of the large rocks was a three-legged black dog.

sentences.simplified: 他跟着这只狗走进草地，然后看到一块红色的石头，上面有一只蛐蛐。
sentences.traditional: 他跟著這隻狗走進草地，然後看到一塊紅色的石頭，上面有一隻蛐蛐。
sentences.pinyin: tā gēn zhe zhè zhī gǒu zǒu jìn cǎo dì rán hòu kàn dào yí kuài hóng sè de shí tou shàng miàn yǒu yì zhī qū qū
sentences.english: He followed this dog and walked into a meadow. Then he saw a red rock, and there was a cricket on it.

sentences.simplified: 这只蛐蛐头是绿色的，腿很大，看起来很厉害……
sentences.traditional: 這隻蛐蛐頭是綠色的，腿很大，看起來很厲害……
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhī qū qū tóu shì lǜ sè de tuǐ hěn dà kàn qi lai hěn lì hai
sentences.english: The cricket’s head was green, its legs were very big, and it looked very fierce …

sentences.simplified: 成名起床后，想起那个梦：那小山好像在哪里见过，那是什么地方呢？
sentences.traditional: 成名起床後，想起那個夢：那小山好像在哪裏見過，那是什麼地方呢？
sentences.pinyin: chéng míng qǐ chuáng hòu xiǎng qǐ nà ge mèng nà xiǎo shān hǎo xiàng zài nǎ lǐ jiàn guò nà shì shén me dì fang ne
sentences.english: After Cheng Ming got up, he thought of that dream: It’s as if I’ve seen that small hill somewhere before. Where was it?

sentences.simplified: 想着想着，成名突然跳了起来：啊！那不就是学校旁边的小山吗？
sentences.traditional: 想著想著，成名突然跳了起來：啊！那不就是學校旁邊的小山嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng zhe xiǎng zhe chéng míng tū rán tiào le qi lai a nà bú jiù shì xué xiào páng biān de xiǎo shān ma
sentences.english: Cheng Ming thought and thought, and suddenly jumped up: Aha! Wasn’t that the small hill next to the school?

sentences.simplified: 以前上学的时候，我经常去那儿玩。那儿会有蛐蛐吗？这个梦是真的吗？
sentences.traditional: 以前上學的時候，我經常去那兒玩。那兒會有蛐蛐嗎？這個夢是真的嗎？
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián shàng xué de shí hou wǒ jīng cháng qù nà'r wán nà'r huì yǒu qū qū ma zhè ge mèng shì zhēn de ma
sentences.english: When I was at school, I often went there to play. Could there be a cricket there? Can this dream be true?

sentences.simplified: 现在的成名也想不了那么多了
sentences.traditional: 現在的成名也想不了那麼多了
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài de chéng míng yě xiǎng bú liǎo nà me duō le
sentences.english: Now Cheng Ming didn’t know the answers.

sentences.traditional: 。夢是不是真的不知道，去看看吧，說不定真的有蛐蛐呢
sentences.pinyin: mèng shì bú shì zhēn de bù zhī dào qù kàn kan ba shuō bu dìng zhēn de yǒu qū qū ne
sentences.english: I don’t know if the dream is real. Let’s go have a look, maybe there really will be a cricket there?

sentences.simplified: ？这么一想，成名慢慢地从床上起来
sentences.traditional: ？這麼一想，成名慢慢地從床上起來
sentences.pinyin: zhè me yì xiǎng chéng míng màn man de cóng chuáng shang qǐ lai
sentences.english: As soon as he had this thought, Cheng Ming slowly rose out of bed, ..

sentences.simplified: ，向村里学校旁边的小山走去
sentences.traditional: ，向村裡學校旁邊的小山走去
sentences.pinyin: xiàng cūn lǐ xué xiào páng biān de xiǎo shān zǒu qù
sentences.english: .. and went to the small hill next to the village school.

sentence_translations: The time had come to hand over a cricket. Cheng Ming didn’t have a cricket, so he was beaten twenty times.
A day went by. Cheng Ming finally found a cricket, and happily went to give it to the mayor.
But as soon as the mayor saw it, he asked how such a small cricket could be given to the emperor.
The mayor was very angry, and Cheng Ming was beaten another twenty times.
Ten days went by, and Cheng Ming still hadn’t handed over a cricket. He was beaten twenty times every day.
After more than ten days, Cheng Ming had been beaten over 200 times.
Now he couldn’t even walk, how could he catch a cricket?
He was lying in bed, thinking to himself: what to do?
My family has no money now. What about selling the house to buy a cricket?
I don’t know if the money from this house would be enough to buy a good cricket either.
Besides, with the house sold, where would my wife and son live?
Being without money means death! Failing to find a cricket means death! Whatever I do it means death!
With these thoughts turning over in his head, Cheng Ming fell asleep.
In a dream, he saw a small hill. Below the hill were many large rocks.
Next to one of the large rocks was a three-legged black dog.
He followed this dog and walked into a meadow. Then he saw a red rock, and there was a cricket on it.
The cricket’s head was green, its legs were very big, and it looked very fierce …
After Cheng Ming got up, he thought of that dream: It’s as if I’ve seen that small hill somewhere before. Where was it?
Cheng Ming thought and thought, and suddenly jumped up: Aha! Wasn’t that the small hill next to the school?
When I was at school, I often went there to play. Could there be a cricket there? Can this dream be true?
Now Cheng Ming didn’t know the answers.
I don’t know if the dream is real. Let’s go have a look, maybe there really will be a cricket there?
As soon as he had this thought, Cheng Ming slowly rose out of bed, ..
.. and went to the small hill next to the village school.
